shadows.name: paper
shadows.purpose: Diffuse depth behind the cream letter.

shadows.name: soft-button
shadows.purpose: Small lift under final garden controls.

motion.name: intro-out
motion.purpose: Opacity to 0, blur to 4px, translate up 10px when growth begins.

motion.name: garden-growth
motion.purpose: ready → growing → garden, followed by automatic native dialog opening; delays 0.45–5.05s and durations 2–3.7s use 1-(1-t)^3 easing.

motion.name: button-hover
motion.purpose: Background and transform transition; translateY(-2px), returning to 0 on active.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Resolve growth, remove sway and all falling leaves/petals and CSS animations/transitions, then focus explicit letter control. Changing preference during growth resolves immediately to garden.

motion.name: canvas-wind
motion.purpose: Independent slow sway; no sway under reduced motion, no painting while hidden.

motion.name: botanical-drift
motion.purpose: Four translucent leaf/petal shapes in ready; 13 below 650px or 23 at larger widths thereafter. Sizes 3–7.3px, alpha 0.35–0.62, slow lateral sway/rotation/flutter. Disabled under reduced motion.

breakpoints.name: compact-width
breakpoints.purpose: CSS mobile typography, spacing and hit target placement at max-width.

breakpoints.name: canvas-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Canvas uses 54 flowers below this width; otherwise min(128, round(width/12)).

breakpoints.name: short-height
breakpoints.purpose: Compact intro and letter at max-height.

components.name: Garden action
components.description: Cream pill used for reading the letter or replaying the garden.

components.name: Return to garden
components.description: Quiet underlined action at the end of the letter.

components.name: Letter close
components.description: Circular 44px close control; sticky in the actual scrolling dialog.

narrative.overview: The fifteen user reference photos and approved four-state brief establish the world: a soft cloudy sky, one layered pink rose, a garden growing from below and a centered cream letter. Preserve that world; the flowers carry the experience and the interface stays quiet.
keyCharacteristics: Pastel atmosphere and dimensional, overlapping petals.
Literata lettering, restrained cream controls and an inset paper frame.
One continuous garden with an optional letter overlay.
dos: Do preserve the reference-led pastel sky, dimensional petals and cream paper.
Do keep the central rose identifiable within the layered garden.
Do preserve internal letter scrolling, visible close control and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't add dashboard framing, navigation sections or oversized controls.
Don't replace flowers with flat spiral symbols, screenshot backgrounds or confetti bursts; falling decoration stays sparse and botanical.
Don't reproduce the reference video's POV caption, browser chrome, monitor or keyboard.
